title: Lentswe le le Ganeng go Itlhoboga
intro: Kgato mo lelapeng le tatlhegelo e latelang tatlhegelo, le fa go ntse jalo lentswe le le lengwe le le ritibetseng le gana go itlhoboga. Pitso e le nngwe fela mo Qur’an e fetola bopelotelele go nna ntlha ya phetogo; a o ka kgona go latedisa dintlha tsa motho yo o neng a bua lentswe leo?
clues: Ke ne ke le lentswe la bopelotelele mo teng ga lelapa le masego a neng a lekwa ke masetlapelo.
Ke ne ka sala mo lelapeng le le lolea ka ntlha ya go latlhegelwa ke khumo le bana.
Ke ne ke itse gore bolwetse le jone bo ne bo tlhasetse molekane yoo, yo mmele wa gagwe o neng o bogisiwa.
Fa tlalelo e nna maswe thata, ke ne ka bitsa ka go gakolola Allah.
Ke ne ka ntsha polelo e le nngwe: Allah ke Boammaaruri, ka jalo nna o le pelotelele.
Ke ne ka bitsa Ayyub ka leina; morago ga moo, Allah o ne a tlosa pogisego mme a tsosolosa lelapa.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go sala le Ayyub ka tatlhegelo le bolwetse, morago ga moo go bitsa bopelotelele .
Go tlhagisa morongwa yo o siameng gore a tlogele setšhaba se se bodileng
Go rapelela botsalo jwa losika lwa isago
Go ranola ditoro mo teng ga kgolegelo ya segosi
Go bona ngwana yo o tshepiwang fa thoko ga noka
trial.answer: Go sala le Ayyub ka tatlhegelo le bolwetse, morago ga moo go bitsa bopelotelele .

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Kgoeletso ya gore Allah ke Boammaaruri le bopelotelele bo a tlhokega
Setlhare sa mokolane fa thoko ga motswedi
Pitso ya go aga sekepe kgakala le makhubu
Toro ya dinaledi di le lesome le bongwe le letsatsi le le tlhabang
Seroto se se neng se rwalwa go bapa le Noka ya Nile
location.answer: Kgoeletso ya gore Allah ke Boammaaruri le bopelotelele bo a tlhokega

outcome.label: Botso
options: Pogisego ya ga Ayyub e ne ya tlosiwa mme lelapa la gagwe la tsosolosiwa
Ngwana yo o sa bolong go letelwa o ne a newa morago ga thapelo ya moopa
Mmusi mongwe yo mmotlana o ne a ranola dingwaga di le supa tsa letlotlo le tlhaelo
Ngwana yo o neng a tshepilwe o ne a namolwa mo metsing a a elelang
Tlhagiso e ne ya tla pele ga morwalela o o senyang
outcome.answer: Pogisego ya ga Ayyub e ne ya tlosiwa mme lelapa la gagwe la tsosolosiwa

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
